root_causes.finding: The continuous NFS permission sidecar changed PostgreSQL PGDATA to mode 0777, but PostgreSQL accepts only 0700 or 0750. Database initialization restarted and four dependent API pods never became ready.

A reclaim queued during validation relinked all persisted sessions, but the in-flight provisioning result overwrote workshop.session_ids with only the ready session. Group reclaim marked the workshop completed while four failed-seat namespaces remained.

red_green_matrix.red: Previous run advertised 40 seats and saturated a worker at 250 pods.
red_green_matrix.green_live: Capacity advertised 10 seats, staged four namespaces first, and peaked at 243 pods without a worker Ready transition.

red_green_matrix.red: Continuous chmod changed PGDATA to 0777 and caused PostgreSQL restart loops during initialization.
red_green_matrix.green_local: Continuous chmod sidecar removed; termination-time cleanup remains and chart contract proves PostgreSQL is the only database container.

red_green_matrix.red: Group reclaim marked completion after reclaiming only one of five persisted sessions.
red_green_matrix.green_local: Reclaim rebuilds workshop session links after in-flight provisioning stops; regression covers failed persisted seats.

release_decision.next_action: Deploy PostgreSQL and reclaim-race corrections, then repeat the five-seat Arena certification.
